I see myself as a bridge between data and people. 
I recently completed my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [predicts an applicant's likely enrollment destination category](capstone.qmd) for
the Willamette University Admissions and Enrollment Management Teams.

I enjoy streamlining workflows, optimizing databases, applying statistical models to real-world problems, and making data interpretable through visualizations. Throughout it all, I thrive in collaborative environments where I can apply my technical skills to connect with business stakeholders and help them make data-driven decisions.

**Currently looking for** Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, and Data Engineer roles
starting January, 2027. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd)!
